characters.name: RHYVORI
characters.title: The First Pulse
characters.identity: RHYVORI moves between the pulse and the reply, holding the line where two rhythms meet.
characters.quote: Start with one beat. We can build the rest together.
characters.story: RHYVORI arrived in the Soundfield when the first frequency went quiet. RHYVORI learned to answer, then to invite, and now keeps the space open for anyone who wants to play.
